source: Anthropic Claude API first-party prices, checked against platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing on 2026-11-09. Check the current prices at https://www.anthropic.com/pricing and edit this file when they change.
notes: haiku = Claude Haiku 5.5, sonnet = Claude Sonnet 5.5, opus = Claude Opus 5.5, fable = Claude Fable 5.2.

Cache writes are 1.25x input for the 5-minute cache and 2x for the 1-hour cache. rightsize reads which one a session writes from Claude Code's settings and environment and from the billing (1 hour on a subscription within its plan, 5 minutes otherwise; helpers always 5 minutes). Behind a gateway it cannot read, add "cacheTtl": "5m" or "1h" here to say so.

Haiku 5.5 is priced by prompt length. A request whose prompt (input, cache reads and cache writes together) is over 100K tokens pays the over100k prices: 0.50 input, 0.625 / 1.00 cache write (5m / 1h), 0.05 cache read, 2.50 output. Each request is priced on its own.
